scope: FileDigest.kt full file: digest lifetime and cleanup
StreamIntegrity.kt full file: streaming allocation bounds
DirectDownloader.kt full file: response and transfer buffers
ParallelDownloader.kt full file: worker count, buffers, response cleanup
NativeProcessSession.kt full file: output accumulation and limited proc reads
LibraryRepository.kt thumbnail cache and LibraryScreens.kt thumbnail references
positive_observations: StreamIntegrity.kt:13 uses one reusable 64 KiB buffer, incrementally updates SHA-256, and returns only the byte count and 32-byte digest; file size does not scale the digest allocation.
FileDigest.kt:27-44 closes the descriptor and stream via use, clears the atomic stream reference, and cancels/joins the cleanup child in finally.
DirectDownloader.kt:222-271 streams into RandomAccessFile using a single 64 KiB buffer; response closes in finally at 286-288. Unknown-length responses are not accumulated in memory.

ParallelDownloader.kt:22,72-73 fixes concurrency to exactly two workers. Each has one 64 KiB transfer buffer at 103; after awaiting workers, merge streams parts using a 64 KiB buffer at 153. All transfer streams and responses use use.

NativeProcessSession.kt:215-242 reads output in 4 KiB chunks, keeps diagnostic tail at 16,384 characters and line at 8,192 characters. Tail can transiently exceed its cap only by the bounded incoming chunk. Continued output or one newline-free line cannot grow either builder without bound. Process streams close in finally at 246-251.
NativeProcessSession.kt:176-185 proc reads allocate a caller-specified bounded buffer (maximum call-site limit 65,536 bytes), reject overflow and return a bounded copy.

LibraryRepository.kt:46-47 limits thumbnail cache to 8 MiB by actual allocationByteCount and requests 192x192 thumbnails at 275. LibraryScreens.kt:60 holds row bitmap in composition-local remembered state. No proven retained bitmap leak was found in this supporting path.

validation.executed: Read-only source inspection and commit verification only
validation.limitations: No runtime heap, native allocation or process PSS measurements were performed. Findings cover proven leaks or unbounded allocations in the assigned paths; no speculative optimization recommendations.
